meta.title: New World Hoiana Resort Review : 24 Hours Inside Da Nang's Hidden Luxury Resort
meta.description:
We just spent an unforgettable night at New World Hoiana Beach Resort  in Danang Vietnam — a hidden coastal paradise between Hoi An and Da Nang. From the airport pickup to the room reveal, the sunrise, breakfast, the spa, and at the Nox Beach Club, this is everything you'll experience at one of Vietnam's most stunning luxury resorts.

If you're researching where to stay near Hoi An or Da Nang, this honest, full resort tour will help you decide.
